name: Milperra Bridge
facts: Milperra Bridge opened in April 1931 as a two‑lane wooden truss, only 4 metres above water, sparking local protests that led to a 5‑metre height compromise.
The 1966 prestressed concrete replacement stretches 85 metres, carries six lanes, and was built in two stages—eastbound first, then westbound—replacing the original wooden span.
Milperra Bridge’s construction coincided with a major upgrade of Milperra and Newbridge Roads, widening them to six lanes from Victoria St Revesby to Kelso Crescent Moorebank.
